newsitems.title: March of Giants x Discord Quest: Claim an Exclusive Avatar Decoration!
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: Claim an Exclusive Avatar Decoration! We are excited to partner with Discord to bring you a limited-time Quest for March of Giants! Earn an exclusive reward simply by watching our trailer. Here is everything you need to know about the reward and how to claim it. Quest Details March of Giants Trailer Quest Requirement: Watch at least 30 seconds of the official March of Giants trailer on Discord. Reward: Exclusive Strikelight Helmet Avatar Decoration. Duration: October 1 – October 7 How to Find & Accept Quests on Discord Open Discord Settings: Open the Discord desktop app and click on the Discover icon on the left side navigation bar. Navigate to Quests: Find the Quests tab. Accept & Complete: Locate the March of Giants quest, click Accept Quest, and complete the requirement (watching the video). Claim Your Reward: Once completed, head back to the Quests tab to claim your reward code or item! Note: Make sure Discord's In-Game Overlay or Activity Status is enabled so your progress registers automatically while playing.

newsitems.title: Upcoming Playtest Roadmap | 2026-2027
newsitems.author: Ubi-Tea
newsitems.contents: Through 2026 and into summer 2027, we’re committed to running playtests and Early Access for you to come try out March of Giants and tell us what you think! As of October 7th 2026, we’ve kicked off the Pioneer playtest.  Head over to our March of Giants steam page to jump into the playtest until October 18th 2026.  We’ll continue to run additional playtests late Winter and Spring 2027, with Early Access kicking off in the summer of 2027. We will share more information closer to the time of these tests. Feedback  Playtests are an important opportunity for us to see how March of Giants performs with a larger group of players and understand where the game still needs improvement. The best places to share gameplay feedback with the development team are: March of Giants Discord r/MarchOfGiants  Progress and Carryover As a reminder, Pioneer rewards you earn in the Pioneer playtest are designed to recognize your participation beyond that playtest. Pandemos, your Pioneer status, and the Early Access Pack will carry forward as described in the Pioneer Program. All other unlocked content, including other Giants unlocked besides Pandemos, will not carry over to future tests or Early Access.

newsitems.title: Player Experience | Pioneer Playtest is Now Open! Runs October 7-18
newsitems.author: Ubi-Tea
newsitems.contents: Pioneer PlaytestThe Pioneer Playtest brings March of Giants back into players' hands with major updates across the game and another opportunity for us to learn from your feedback.March of Giants is a 4v4 War MOBA where you play as a Giant, command Soldiers, deploy Battleworks, and work with your team to destroy two of the opposing team's three Bastions while defending your own.A lot has changed since our first Closed Alpha, including major updates to Soldiers, Battleworks, neutral objectives, itemization, Giants, and match pacing. Just as importantly, this is still a playtest. You may encounter bugs, balance issues, unfinished features, or other unexpected moments while playing.This guide brings together the practical information you'll need before and during the Pioneer Playtest, including how to get access, what's changed, where to send feedback, how to report bugs, and where to go if you run into account or technical issues.How to Sign UpIf you’re new to March of Giants:Head to the March of Giants Steam page.Click Join the Playtest under March of Giants Playtest.Steam will notify you when access has been granted.Download March of Giants directly from your Steam Library.Returning from the Closed Alpha in September 2025? You're already invited. Just head to your Steam Library and install the game!You’ll also need a Ubisoft Connect account to play. You can sign in or create an account when you launch the game.ScheduleThe March of Giants Pioneer Playtest runs from October 7th at 10 AM EDT through October 18th, 2026.October 12th at 10 AM EDT: Pandemos joins the Pioneer Playtest and becomes available to players who complete the Pioneer Program requirements.We'll communicate any changes to server availability, maintenance, or the playtest schedule through our official channels.What's IncludedThe Pioneer Playtest will be available on PC through Steam in supported North American and European countries.Supported Languages:EnglishFrenchGermanSpanishThe Pioneer Playtest also includes major changes across many of the systems that define March of Giants. Since Closed Alpha, we've focused heavily on match pacing, neutral objectives, itemization, battlefield clarity, and giving players more ways to control and build around Soldiers and Battleworks.New GiantsTwo new Giants join the roster during the Pioneer Playtest, bringing the roster count to 17.Elaris is a mobile ranged damage dealer who can specialize in basic attacks or build around her long-range abilities.Pandemos joins the playtest on October 12. Learn more about him when he is fully revealed later in the playtest!Giant AccessAll players begin the Pioneer Playtest with Victoria, Solace, Kragg, and Elaris unlocked, along with four additional randomly selected Giants.Additional Giants can be unlocked using Giant Tokens, which are rewarded for completing in-game challengesPandemos is unlocked separately through the Pioneer Program when he becomes available on October 12th.More Control Over SoldiersSoldiers are central to both fighting and taking objectives in March of Giants. They rally around your Giant and can follow you between lanes, through the spaces between objectives, or directly into combat.For the Pioneer Playtest, we've added more ways to control and build around your Soldiers. You can redirect Soldier charges after sending them forward, while smaller groups can be detached to scout contested areas.Soldiers can also collect Merits and Supplies, and players who invest heavily into Soldier-focused builds can increase their effectiveness throughout the match.Expanded BattleworksBattleworks let you spend Supplies to deploy structures and reinforcements directly onto the battlefield. They can support a push, reinforce a defensive position, or help counter an opponent's strategy.Returning Battleworks include:Soldier Drop, which delivers additional Soldiers directly to your positionIronclad, an armored tank that helps your team push against Outposts and BastionsTrench, which creates defensive positions against incoming SoldiersGiantslayer Bunker, which provides defensive firepower and area controlThe Pioneer Playtest also introduces Cavalry, a new offensive Battlework designed to destroy enemy Battleworks, slow Giants caught in its charge, and help break heavily fortified positions.Army Camps and AugmentsThe spaces between lanes now contain more objectives and opportunities to gain an advantage.We've added Army Camps that provide Supplies, Merits, vision, and access to the shop without needing to Recall. Destroy an enemy Army Camp to deny those resources while also granting your team an Augment Point.Augments modify your Giant's abilities during a match and can change properties such as range, area of effect, effect duration, or number of projectiles.A.M.S. AbominationA new late-game objective, the A.M.S. Abomination, enters the battlefield at the 12-minute mark and roams around the center of the map.Defeating it requires team coordination and rewards an Augmen...

newsitems.title: Giant Spotlight: Elaris
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: The Dream of StarsA huge comet blazed across the night sky and the people of Dawnline looked up in awe and hope as Elaris was born. She is a manifestation of the human mind and spirit's ability to connect with the depth in the spheres above.Elaris is scientific, audacious, and a little cocky. A celebrity backed by the love of her people, she is smart and predictive whilst sometimes a little too pleased to point out when she was right. Narrated by @Scok AbilityNameDescriptionIconPassiveEscalating QuasarWhen Elaris casts an ability, she receives a temporary boost to her attack speed. When she lands a basic attack, she receives a boost to her Alchemic DamageQStellar FlareDeals damage, reveals enemies and extends her range temporarily if it hits an enemy GiantWPulsarLaunches a slow-moving singularity that passes through enemies, dealing damage as it travels. When it reaches the end of its range, or when reactivated, it will exploding, dealing additional damage and silencing enemy GiantsEQuantum StrikeBlink to a targeted position, and fire on the closest enemy in range upon reappearingUltMeteoric TriangulationThe next three base attacks will each call down a meteor strike after a short delay, dealing damage in a large area and slowing enemies down Elaris’ war-shell is a custom-built orrery for calculating the dances of the spheres and calling down their cosmic effects. It acts as both a prediction tool and as a channel for her abilities.Draw your victory in the stars; choose this audacious ranged ingenue as your giant!

newsitems.title: Giant Spotlight: Ossuary | Pioneer Playtest October 7-18
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: The Nightmare of the FallenAfter a century of war, Dawnline’s dead outnumbered its cemeteries. The Memorial Spire rose in their place: a vast vertical mausoleum, built ever higher as each floor filled, until it became a gothic monument to loss. From its memory and grief came Ossuary, a stoic archivist who remembers every name, battle and death within the Spire.  Ability Name Description Icon Unique SoldiersGhost SoldiersOssuary does not use conventional Soldiers, instead, he converts allied Soldiers over time and enemy Soldiers you kill into Ghost Soldiers. Ghost Soldiers can travel through walls but cannot be recalled once deployedPassive Advance of the Endless Tomb Grants increased attack speed when an ability is cast, with double effect when health is low  Q Unbinding Slash Slashes at the enemy, causing direct damage and damage over time  W Boneshard Barrage Fires off shards of bone in a small arc for multi-hit damage, while also gaining shield for each projectile that hits  E Burial Shroud Grants increased movement speed and Intimidation, causing enemy soldiers to flee in fear  Ult Phantom Liberators Sends a huge wave of spectral soldiers rushing forward through walls, attacking enemies and defenses along their path while revealing parts of the map.   Ossuary gathers mementos from the fallen, etching their names into its endless bone arm and tending their memory like a garden. There is peace for everyone in the Spire. Will you choose Ossuary and bring them all home?

newsitems.title: Giant Spotlight: Voidmaster | Pioneer Playtest October 7-18
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: The Nightmare of the Occult“He waits beneath thought. He drinks beneath death. He comes.” The chanting of the cultists that speak for the Voidmaster is heavy and rhythmic. Wherever the entity appears, minds bend toward it. Soldiers become worshippers, worshippers become a congregation, and it speaks and chants with one voice.  With every mind surrendered and every death offered in its presence, Voidmaster becomes more substantial and more powerful. Its cultists claim this is only an aspect of something immeasurably greater waiting beyond the Void Desolate. Perhaps enough people believing in it will make them right. Ability Name Description Icon Passive A Thousand Eyes Each basic attack will open an eye. With two eyes open, the next ability becomes stronger  Q Void Sphere A close-range attack that unfurls three void spheres at a target, and then a final fourth doing even more damage  W Tentacle’s Grasp Pulls an enemy in, dealing moderate damage and inflicting Slow. Giants pulled into structures get stunned  E Ritual of Madness Sends out a psychotic pulse, enemy Giants that are being attacked by your Soldiers are stunned   Ult Eldritch Ascension Unleash your full Eldritch might, terrifying enemy Soldiers and preventing them from attacking you while gaining a powerful shield and increased movement and attack speed Voidmaster’s war-shell started as a dirigible designed to destroy the nightmare if its cultists dreamt it into existence. It failed; its crew was immediately brainwashed and lowered the vessel so that the Voidmaster could graft itself onto the hull. Voidmaster’s crew complement are all dedicated cultists who rarely, if ever, leave their post, and speak in a disturbing unison whenever they open comms. Feed the void. Let it become real. Choose Voidmaster as your giant.

newsitems.title: Giant Spotlight: Wolfgang
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: The Nightmare of RageWolfgang does not consider himself a monster. He considers himself the price of victory. Court-martialed for his war crimes and sent for execution, his Dawnline followers freed this raging nightmare and dreamt him into an avatar of fury.AbilityNameDescriptionIconUnique SoldiersWerewolf SoldiersSoldiers that rally to Wolfgang are transformed into werewolves, which move faster and deal more damage against lane units. Werewolves cannot be recalled or redirected PassiveThe Beast WithinLanding attacks and abilities with Wolfgang builds his rage meter. When maxed, he transforms into The Beast,   QWarbound SavageryDeals damage in a cone. When transformed, also grants damage reduction WFeral LungeLeaps onto the enemy, dealing damage and causing them to be slowed. When transformed, also grants life steal  EChain of RageWhen assaulting an enemy Giant with werewolf Soldiers, activate this ability to pull the Giant towards Wolfgang. When transformed, affected Giants are also stunned. UltThe Howling HuntWolfgang transforms into the Beast, revealing the position of all enemy giants and buffing all his other abilities  Educated, calculating and utterly convinced of his own necessity, he regards restraint as weakness and collateral damage as a calculation lesser commanders are too cowardly to make. In human form, his rage is controlled: seductive, articulate and dangerous precisely because there is logic behind it.In Beast form, that restraint collapses. The philosophy remains, but language gives way to instinct: short commands, snarled threats and brutal certainty. Wolfgang does not become inept when he transforms. He just stops explaining himself.Will you choose Wolfgang and become the necessary evil?

newsitems.title: Giant Spotlight: Solace
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: The Dream of FaithFor generations, the people of Archaia had turned their backs on the old gods. Then came Kragg, the Voidmaster, and a war without end. In desperation, Duskline began to pray again. Solace answered. He emerged speaking the ancient language of the Wardens, certain that he carries their divine purpose. Thoughtful, compassionate and unwavering in his faith, he seeks to end the war and return light to Archaia. But one question follows him onto every battlefield: does he truly hear the forgotten gods, or only the echo of the people who dreamed him? AbilityNameDescriptionPassiveFaith of the FightersRegenerates energy when his Soldiers assault enemy Giants QWarden’s Judgement Either restores some of an ally’s health or deal damage to an enemy, with extra damage if the enemy is stunned WHoly Conversion Converts enemy soldiers to your cause, and makes your own soldiers temporarily invulnerable ERepentance Bell A ranged attack that deals damage within a circular radius, with additional damage and a stun effect in the center of it UltWrath of Absolution Channels and releases a large holy wave travelling across the whole battlefield, healing allies while inflicting Slow on enemies His war-shell is a mobile cathedral, channeling miraculous powers to heal allies, shield the faithful and even convert enemy troops. Faith is wavering. Answer the call as Solace and make them believe.

newsitems.title: Giant Spotlight: Kragg
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: The Nightmare of StrengthFar more intelligent than his monstrous frame suggests, Kragg fights for Duskline under an uneasy bargain: help them win the war and earn his freedom. It seems that neither side intends to keep its promise. His colossal war-shell serves as both weapon and prison, restraining Kragg until his guards decide to unleash him. Ability Name Description Icon Passive Sadist’s Vigor Each basic attack will buff Kragg’s defence temporarily  Q Brutal Charge Kragg charges forwards, dealing damage and pushing enemy Giants. Enemies colliding with a structure take additional damage and are stunned  W Shattered Earth Creates a circular pool of quicksand on the battlefield- Enemies caught in the swirling sands will be drawn towards its center, and take damage over time  E Monstrous Presence  Applies a buff to an ally grants them additional armor. Targeting an enemy Giant reduces their armor and applies a DoT  Ult Traitor’s Freedom Loosens Kragg’s chains to unleash a massive AoE attack, stunning enemies in range. It also buffs his kinetic damage and increases his movement speed   Kragg is the largest of all the Giants, with very questionable allegiances. Are you ready to disrupt the battlefield, dominate your opponents, and unleash a towering hulk of earth-shattering rage?

newsitems.title: Giant Spotlight: Victoria
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: The Dream of VictoryA fierce, inspiring force who burns through the enemy ranks in pursuit of victory at any cost, Victoria wields the Angelflame to scorch the battlefield. Her marble-like skin protects her from the weapon’s noxious effects, but her elite crew enjoys no such immunity. To Victoria, sacrifice is simply salvation.AbilityNameDescriptionPassiveScorched AngelflameAttacks with Victoria's flamethrower spear also scorch enemies, dealing burn damage over time that can stackQBurning ArcSprays a widened flame, dealing damage in a coneWWinged VictoryDashing ahead, Victoria strikes all foes in her path. Increases her shield ESupercharged SpearVictoria's spear burns brighter, stunning the first enemy she hits and increasing her attack speed for a short whileUltOn History's PyreVictoria leaps into the air and lands on an enemy Giant, engulfing them in flames and stunning them In an ever-locked conflict, the people of Dawnline dreamed of a victory unbound by the tragedies of the war. As such she appeared to them. An angel of salvation.To choose Victoria is to choose inspiring, poetic deeds but also intense, hard-hearted sacrifice. Are you willing to give it all?

newsitems.title: March of Giants получила новый геймплейный трейлер - открытое тестирование пройдёт с 7 по 18 октября
newsitems.contents: Разработчики March of Giants представили новый геймплейный трейлер, посвящённый предстоящему плейтесту. В ролике показали игровой процесс, основные механики и Гигантов, которые будут доступны участникам тестирования, а также впервые продемонстрировали нового персонажа Пандемоса. Тестирование стартует 7 октября в 10:00 по EDT и продлится до 18 октября. Тестирование будет доступно игрокам из Северной Америки и ряда европейских стран, включая Латвию, Литву, Эстонию, Германию, Францию и Великобританию. Для участия необходимо запросить доступ через страницу March of Giants в Steam. Игроки, принимавшие участие в закрытой альфе в сентябре 2025 года, получат доступ автоматически. Также потребуется аккаунт Ubisoft и установленный Ubisoft Connect. Во время тестирования участники смогут получать очки за завершённые PvP-матчи. Победа принесёт 100 очков, поражение — 50. После достижения 1000 очков игрок получит статус "первопроходец" и награды, включая Пандемоса, специальную медаль и бесплатный набор для будущего раннего доступа.

newsitems.title: Our Vision for March of Giants
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: Our Vision for March of GiantsOur studio was founded six years ago and built from the ground up to make March of Giants, our take on the MOBA genre.From the very beginning, we knew we wanted to make a MOBA. We enjoy the unique design challenges, deeply engaged communities, and competitive spirit that define the genre. We also have tremendous respect for the systems that make them so rewarding to play: mastering a character, understanding the map and game flow, and coordinating with your team. Simply put, our goal is to make a game that delivers on the full MOBA experience.A World In An Endless WarWe looked toward the First World War and the industrial era surrounding it for inspiration, particularly its trenches, artillery, enormous armies, fortified positions, and shifting frontlines.Those ideas fit naturally with the structure we envision for MOBAs. Lanes become fronts to advance and defend. Soldiers become armies moving across them. Objectives represent territory worth fighting over.But we did not want March of Giants to be purely grounded in a historical setting. That industrial-war foundation is combined with a darker fairy-tale world that lets us move well beyond reality. Our Giants can draw from technology, folklore, experimentation, military history, monsters, and other ideas that fit within the world we've created.Giants are powerful combatants on their own, but they're also commanders within a much larger battle. Their influence extends beyond their own abilities through the Soldiers that fight alongside them and the Battleworks they deploy across the battlefield.Building on the Original VisionWhen we introduced March of Giants during our Closed Alpha in September 2025, it was our first opportunity to see how a large group of players experienced our game. We gathered as much feedback as we could, played countless matches with the community, and immediately began working to improve the game.To everyone who played in the Closed Alpha, your feedback was invaluable in shaping the future of March of Giants and making the game what it is today. We cannot thank you enough.The foundations of March of Giants will still be familiar to those who have played, but many of the systems around them have evolved. We've expanded the role Soldiers can play during a match, added more interaction and counterplay around Battleworks, and made the spaces between lanes much more important to progression and map control. Itemization has also been expanded to support more specialized builds and different ways to play each Giant.We've added new Giants, continued updating the returning roster, and made broader improvements across the map, UI, visuals, animations, game clarity, and many other parts of the game.Welcome, and Welcome BackDuring the transition to Ubisoft, much of our attention needed to remain focused inside the studio. Now we're ready to open the game again and bring players back into the development process with the Pioneer Playtest.We'll be hosting a YouTube Premiere on October 7, where members of the development team will give you a closer look at March of Giants and kick off the Pioneer Playtest. We're also reopening discussion in the official March of Giants Discord so players can reconnect, talk about the game, and share feedback throughout the playtest.During Closed Alpha, we said that PvP games are a conversation. Internal testing can tell us a lot, but it cannot replace seeing how players use these systems, what strategies emerge, and where we still need to improve.The Pioneer Playtest is our next chance to learn from you, and we're ready to see what you do with the game.Whether you were with us during Closed Alpha or are discovering March of Giants for the first time, thank you for joining us.We'll see you on the front.- March of Giants Development Team

newsitems.title: March of Giants' Pioneer Playtest Begins on October 7
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: The March of Giants Pioneer Playtest begins October 7 and runs through October 18, 2026. Whether you played in our first Closed Alpha or you’re joining us for the first time, here's how to get signed up for the playtest. The Pioneer Playtest Begins October 7The Pioneer Playtest opens on October 7 at 10 AM EDT through Steam. This playtest is open to players in North America and supported European countries, with servers available for both regions.We've added localization for English, French, German, and Spanish, with additional languages and server support planned for future playtests.Watch the October 7 PremiereWe’re kicking things off with a YouTube Premiere on October 7, giving you a closer look at March of Giants and what’s coming in the Pioneer Playtest. We'll be showing some gameplay, going over the basics of how to play the game, talking the Giants available in the playtest - including a new member of the roster, and giving you a peek at future of the game! How to Join the PlaytestIf you’re new to March of Giants:Head to our March of Giants Steam page.Click Request Access under March of Giants Playtest.Steam will notify you when access has been granted.Download March of Giants directly from your Steam Library.We plan to keep invitations open throughout the Pioneer Playtest. We are using this playtest to help us finetune our server capacity, so there may be periods where we may need to pause invitations to give us time to scale up our server infrastructure or hold invitations entirely.You’ll also need Ubisoft Connect and an Ubisoft Account to play. You can sign in or create an account when you launch the game.Feel Free to Share Your GameplayThis playtest will not have an NDA or watermark, so you can stream, record, and share any content from the game. We’re looking forward to seeing your matches, clips, streams, and hearing your feedback throughout the test. You might even spot the occasional dev in a match!Played in the First Closed Alpha?You're already invited! Everyone who played in the March of Giants Closed Alpha in September 2025 is automatically included in the Pioneer Playtest. You do not need to request access again, but it is important to note you will not receive a new Steam access notification at the start of the playtest. When the playtest opens on October 7 at 10 AM EDT, find March of Giants in your Steam Library, download it, and start playing. Returning players will also need to have an Ubisoft Connect account to play.The Pioneer ProgramWe want to recognize and celebrate the most active players throughout the playtest, so we are introducing the Pioneer Program. During the Pioneer Playtest, completing PvP matches earns Pioneer Points. Reach 1,000 Pioneer Points to become a Pioneer and unlock rewards during the playtest and Early Access.Pioneer RewardsPandemos: Permanently unlock our newest Giant when he arrives on October 12 - for this and all future playtests, and when March of Giants enters Early Access.Pioneer Medal: Be recognized as a Pioneer beside your name in every match.Early Access Pack: Receive a free Early Access Pack, including exclusive profile customizations, when March of Giants enters Early Access. Early Access date to be announced.Earn Pioneer PointsPioneer Points are earned by completing PvP matches:Win: 100 Pioneer PointsLoss: 50 Pioneer PointsOnly completed PvP matches award Pioneer Points. Leaving a match before it ends will not award points. PvE and Custom Games do not contribute to Pioneer progress.Progress Faster with a 20% Pioneer Point BoostPlayers can unlock a 20% Pioneer Point boost in one of two ways:Watch participating March of Giants streamers on TwitchJoin the official March of Giants Discord and claim a booster codeBoth methods unlock the same 20% boost and do not stack.With the boost active:Win: 120 Pioneer PointsLoss: 60 Pioneer PointsOnce unlocked, the boost remains active for the rest of the Pioneer Playtest.TwitchWatch participating March of Giants streamers on Twitch for 1 hour to unlock the 20% boost.Players must link their Twitch account to their Ubisoft account through Ubisoft Connect and watch participating streams while logged in to Twitch. Need information on how to connect your Ubisoft Account to your Twitch Account? Head to this support page.DiscordPlayers can also unlock the 20% boost by joining the official March of Giants Discord.After joining, head to the #get-pioneer-booster-here channel for instructions on how to claim a booster code and redeem it for the remainder of the Pioneer Playtest.You only need one code! The Twitch Drop and Discord codes provide the same benefit, so redeeming both won’t give you an additional boost.Where You Can PlayAustriaBelgiumBulgariaCroatiaCyprusCzechiaDenmarkEstoniaFinlandFranceGermanyGreeceHungaryIrelandItalyLatviaLithuaniaLuxembourgMaltaNetherlandsPolandPortugalRomaniaSlovakiaSloveniaSpainSwedenAlbaniaBosnia and HerzegovinaKosovoMontenegroNorth MacedoniaSerbiaLiechtensteinMonacoSwitzerlandUnited Kingdom...

newsitems.title: March of Giants Playtest Regional Access Update
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: Our next March of Giants playtest is right around the corner, and we have an update for everyone who has requested access through Steam.Everyone in our supported regions who had already signed up for the March of Giants Steam Playtest will be granted access to the upcoming playtest. If you joined us for the September 2025 Closed Alpha, you're good to go and don't need to do anything else.If you previously requested access but weren't selected for the Closed Alpha, Steam may send you a notification letting you know that you've been added to the March of Giants Playtest.Please note that the playtest is not yet available to download or play. We'll be sharing more information very soon about when you'll be able to download the game and begin playing!Regional AccessFor the upcoming playtest, our officially supported regions are North America and Europe. Going forward, new Steam Playtest sign-ups will also be limited to players in these regions.Some players outside North America and Europe may have already been granted access before these regional restrictions were applied. If you've already been granted access through Steam, you'll still be able to participate in this playtest.Please keep in mind that our servers for this test will only be located in North America and Europe. Players connecting from farther away may experience increased latency and connection issues. The upcoming playtest will support the following languages:EnglishFrenchGermanSpanishWe know there are players around the world who are eager to get their hands on March of Giants, and we're excited to bring the game to more regions as development continues and we're able to properly support them.We'll have much more to share about the upcoming playtest very soon!
